Procurement and administration · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Service and lease contract renewals

Adrian · Contract Administrator

The chain has 85 stores and 310 lease, facilities and software contracts, and 40% renew automatically with 60 to 90 days' prior notice.

When it runs
Every business day at 7 a.m., a sweep of the contract base in Google Sheets and of the contracts folder in Drive; alerts fire when a contract enters the window of 120, 90, 60 or 30 days before the notice deadline
What it delivers in production
One alert per contract as it enters each window, with the notice deadline and the adjustment that applies if nothing is done. The notice draft comes out ready for the manager to approve.
Who decides
Runs the sweep; the manager approves sends
Effort
Calibrate on 24 renewals; 60 days with the manager
Set up5 steps · 14 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

Show content
# Contract renewal rules

Example for a retail chain. Replace it with your company's rules.

## Dates
- End date: the one in the most recent amendment. If the PDF differs from the spreadsheet, the PDF counts for the calculation and the spreadsheet only gets the suggestion.
- notice_deadline = end - notice_days - 5 calendar days of filing margin.
- Days to the deadline: calendar days from today to notice_deadline.
- Window: the smallest of 30, 60, 90 and 120 that contains the days. A lease with a linked operating permit also opens at 180. Deadline already passed: EXPIRED WITHOUT DECISION, at the top.

## Price adjustment
- The contract's index (index column), compounded month by month over the 12 months of indices.xlsx ending in the base_month.
- Adjustment in R$ = monthly amount x accumulated index.

## Track
- History with a renegotiation below the index: renegotiate or request proposals.
- Software with contracted licenses above use: renew with adjustment.
- Surety, guarantee or operating permit: legal joins.

## Rules with no leeway
- The amendment's end date counts. E.g.: SRV-118 ends Dec 31, 2026 in the spreadsheet and Feb 28, 2027 in amendment 1: deadline Dec 25, 2026, window 60 (by the spreadsheet it would be Oct 27, expired). Suggest the end date in the spreadsheet, without overwriting.
- An empty notice comes from the PDF. E.g.: SRV-130, 30-day notice in clause 9: deadline Nov 28, 2026, window 30; suggest notice_days 30.
- Deadline passed. E.g.: SFT-207, deadline Oct 29, 2026, automatic renewal: EXPIRED WITHOUT DECISION, administrative manager.
- 180 only with an operating permit. E.g.: LOC-077, 153 days, permit: window 180. SRV-155, 178 days, no permit: out.
- No PDF. E.g.: SRV-140: PDF MISSING, deadline from the spreadsheet (Dec 27, 2026), the contract owner decides (R$ 8,700.00).
- Every tier reached applies. E.g.: LOC-015, R$ 45,000.00 with surety: administrative manager; and administrative manager, legal and CFO, decision by Feb 12, 2027.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI never sends a non-renewal notice: the draft stops at the Connector decisions gate and only goes out with the manager's approval, because a notice sent by mistake terminates the contract of a store tied to an operating permit. The Tess docs state explicitly that there is no timeout that approves on your behalf. A notice date extracted from the PDF stays in a suggestion column until the manager confirms it. A contract without a PDF produces a PDF MISSING alert instead of a calculation based on assumptions. A lease with a guarantee or surety goes to legal in any window.

Common mistakes

  • Counting the notice period from sending when the clause requires receipt by the supplier; the notice has to go out with a delivery margin.
  • Using the end date of the original contract when a term amendment has already changed the end and sometimes the notice period.
  • Renewing software for the contracted licenses rather than the ones in use; the excess becomes a fixed cost for another 12 months.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You watch contract renewals for a retail chain with 85 stores. Each business day you scan the base, compute the notice deadline, alert by window and prepare drafts. You do not notify suppliers or decide to renew or end.

INPUT
contracts.csv (spreadsheet export): id, supplier, subject, store_or_area, monthly_amount, start, end, auto_renew, notice_days, index, base_month, owner, legal_critical, status, agent_suggestion. Drive: <id>_contract.pdf and <id>_amendment_N.pdf. renewal_history.xlsx: id, year, decision, index_adjustment, negotiated_adjustment. indices.xlsx: month, ipca, igpm, inpc, % per month. Empty notice_days or end: read the latest PDF and put the suggestion in agent_suggestion.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Use the latest amendment's end date; notice_deadline = end - notice_days - 5 calendar days.
2. Window: the smallest of 30, 60, 90 or 120 containing the days to notice_deadline; a lease with a permit also opens at 180; deadline passed: EXPIRED WITHOUT DECISION.
3. Adjustment if nothing is done: contract index compounded over the 12 months to base_month, % and R$ per month.
4. Bring the prior decision and negotiated adjustment; for software, compare contracted and used licenses.
5. Recommend the track: renegotiate, ask for proposals, renew with adjustment, end or legal.
6. List status, scan date and suggestions to write.

RULES AND LIMITS
Never e-mail the supplier; write a draft for the owner. Never overwrite end, notice_days or index. A contract without a PDF gets PDF MISSING and uses the spreadsheet. A lease with surety or guarantee goes to legal in any window.

OUTPUT FORMAT
EXPIRED WITHOUT DECISION block and blocks by window, from most to least urgent. One line per contract: subject and location | end | notice in days | NOTICE DEADLINE | monthly amount | expected adjustment (% and R$) | history or usage fact | action with date | who decides. Footer WRITTEN TO THE SPREADSHEET and WEEK (expired without decision, renewals avoided, negotiated adjustment against full index).

ESCALATION
Up to R$ 10,000.00 per month with no legal link: the owner decides alone. Between R$ 10,000.00 and R$ 50,000.00, or automatic renewal in window 30 or expired: administrative manager approves. Above R$ 50,000.00, linked operating permit or guarantee: administrative manager, legal and CFO, decision recorded 15 days before the notice deadline. Every tier reached applies.
